reviews.t: Two ingredients...parrafin and petroleum
reviews.x: What a rip off! It had Two ingredients...petroleum and paraffin!  Basically, wax and grease!  Don’t waste your money like I did!  Shame on me!

reviews.t: This is Vasoline
reviews.x: I love Elta MD and feel embarrassed that 1. I bought this product and 2. that they would even make and market this. The ingredients are petrolatum and paraffin, essentially Vasoline. I was hoping for an amazing moisturizer, which I guess Vasoline is and which you can buy for a few dollars. I will still buy their sunscreen, but buyers beware that what you get with this is just a pretty container.

reviews.t: Miracle Balm/Lotion
reviews.x: After wearing face masks all day my face has become incredibly chapped, it is so dry and flaky... this lotion has given me the most relief and best results.  I was introduced to this lotion while getting moisturizing facial.  My aesthetician refers to it as 'melting lotion' because while it is labeled as a lotion it resembles a balm.  I have been using this lotion multiple times a day and it has not caused a single breakout (I am acne prone) and my skin is noticeably softer. This is a miracle lo

reviews.t: Soft, supple skin
reviews.x: I love that this product has no scent, glides on easily and keeps my skin hydrated and soft. I just use a little bit under my eyes, on my face and my cuticles. I use it after showering in the morning and before bed. I’ve noticed my skin feels supple after using it, not tight and dry.

reviews.t: How old the product is.
reviews.x: This product appears to be old. It is granulated and difficult to remove from the jar.

reviews.t: This is literally just Vaseline. Do not buy.
reviews.x: I like this brand but this is a waste of money. It's literally just Vaseline repackaged. I also think this is misleading because it's not a moisturizer. It states on the package that you have to moisturize first and then apply this. I know how occlusive work but I was looking for an actual intense moisturizer that doesn't sit on top of my skin and rub off on material.

reviews.t: Elta MD Lotion is easily absorbed and makes my dry skin feel great
reviews.x: Elta MD Lotion is easily absorbed and makes my dry skin feel great. I use it twice a day.  Even here in Houston's humid climate, the lotion does not make my skin feel sticky like all the other lotions I've tried.  In fact, before I started using it, I hardly ever finished using a bottle of lotion.  Now I'm on my fourth bottle of Elta MD.

reviews.t: SUPER moisturizing
reviews.x: Really impressed with all of EltaMD products and the lotion is no different. Feels great on the skin and lasts all day. Very moisturizing, great for dry to normal skin. Non-greasy. One of the best all over body lotions I have used and very affordable. Would highly recommend.

reviews.t: Was not at all what I expected
reviews.x: I've used EltaMD daily lotion with sunscreen & so I thought I'd try one without sunscreen. Even though it says lotion, the one I got is more like a solidified fat (think coconut oil at colder temperature) which is fine. Not at all what I was looking for and I didn't get to return it for exchange due to dealing with the shut-down. Product should have a better description to avoid disappointed buyers,

reviews.t: Superior Product
reviews.x: I'm a 63 year old male. Im not into products simply to moisture my skin or smell nice. This product is used on my skin grafts. The emresult of a tragic accident. It is the absolute best at retaining moisture to severely damaged skin. Its properties relieve the pain and discomfort associated with grafting.  I can't live contently without th I s product.

reviews.t: The best moisturizer I have ever used!
reviews.x: This moisturizer is working wonders on my 96 year old mother’s skin!  She had been sick & her skin so dry that it was flaky.  This goes on a little oily, but sinks in and really moisturizes.  The best I have ever used!

reviews.t: I love this product
reviews.x: Has no smell, you can use all over including face and it really hydrates skin. EltaMD products never disappoint me.

reviews.t: Contains coconut, Cocamidopropyl Betaine
reviews.x: I've read all the positive reviews. For use,, gentle, sensitive, all skin types. That's not true.  I can't use this because it contains coconut, Cocamidopropyl Betaine. There's alot of lotions, creams, gels; that say for sensitive skin. Even for skin that sufferers from conditions. I'm allergic to coconut. That means any products that use coconut additives, I'm allergic too. And my face gets a severe burn. I think this would be perfect, if coconut additives weren't added.

reviews.t: and it has a nice satin feel to it
reviews.x: This works well as a moisturizer, and it has a nice satin feel to it!  I love it mostly because it doesn't cause me to break out. I find that many body lotions, even though I don't use them directly on my face, cause me to break out. (If I touch my face with lotioned hands, I experience breakouts.) This lotion does not do this!  Overall, I love EltaMD products and find them to be so sensitive, yet effective on the skin.

reviews.t: Best face and body lotion I've found so far.
reviews.x: This reasonably priced lotion has no scent, has a velvetly feel, goes on smoothly, works great on face and body, keeps skin hydrated, and, best of all.... does not leave a sticky residue on your hands.  Will most other lotions, I feel that I need to wash, or at least rinse, my hands after application.  (Review sumitted by Kelly, Chris' wife.)

reviews.t: Look at ingredients- this is a rip off
reviews.x: Petroleum and paraffin. Thats it. Not what is advertised as ingredients here! A lot of money to pay for vaseline and candle wax

reviews.t: Cream
reviews.x: Oh My !  Fantastic...  wonderful with my face mask at night also!  Face looking only still old but not ancient!!!!!!!!!

reviews.t: Exactly what I Needed
reviews.x: This stuff is awesome follow directions and you will not be disappointed.  A little bit goes a long way.

reviews.t: SUPER MOISTURING!
reviews.x: A little goes a long way with this! I thought it was more of a cream but it's actually like a vaseline consistency except it it way more spreadable. It almost melts into your hands and that is lovely. Definitely too heavy for daytime use. I use it at night on my face and I also mix it with my body lotion. Only a small amount is necessary to get the job done which I love and the value of this is perfect for me.

reviews.t: Does the job.  Xlnt product.  Recommended by dermatologist.
reviews.x: I like everything about it.  You only use a little, so this jar goes a long way.  It can, at times, have a bit of a greasy feel.  I'm working on ridding my face and neck of the beginning of wrinkles.  It seems to be helping.  This, after years of products that everyone knows about, brands that are highly advertised.... that did not do the job.  At this point:  I do recommend giving this a try.

reviews.t: The Best Elta MD Lotion for allover
reviews.x: This lotion is perfect!  Light and non-greasy for use anywhere on your body.  I have used it on my face and it actually works better than my expensive moisturizer.  It also does not have a heavy scent so you can still wear perfume without competing with another scent.  My dermatologist recommends the entire Elta MD line and I did not know this beforehand.  The daily sunscreen is also terrific.

reviews.t: Leaves waxy coat that is hard to wash off.
reviews.x: This lotion is unlike any I've ever used. It doesn't absorb but instead forms an almost wax-like coat on my skin. Warm/hot water or even mild face wash don't even touch this stuff, I need to scrub my face with soap, twice, to get it off. If I don't wash it off, I can tell it's still there for days. So I guess it does a good job at forming a barrier between your skin and the rest of the world?

reviews.t: The moisturizing portion of the product is adequate for sensitive skinI
reviews.x: I am going to keep trying to use the moisturizer for another two weeks to see if i continue to follow each application with red splotches and raised skin.  I really wanted this to work because it is not thick, leaving me with heavy oil after using it.  However, it does irritate my skin, which creates the need to constant itching.

reviews.t: Value and it WORKS all day!
reviews.x: Best EVER for moisture! It will "at first" feel greasy to your fingers but it melts right into your face and relieves dryness all day w/o weight. Give it 10 seconds. Plus affordable and it WORKS! One of my most favorite buys on Amazon!

reviews.t: La realidad esto es solo una barra de manteca.
reviews.x: Pensé que era una crema o locion humectante, pero resultó ser una barra de manteca en tarro.Cuando te la pones se derrite en tu cara y cuerpo, pareces listo para ser cocinado ja. Más barato usar olive oil.$$$

claims.text: Many reviewers praise it as highly moisturizing and effective for very dry or damaged skin, keeping skin hydrated and soft.
Several reviewers criticize it as essentially just Vaseline/petrolatum and paraffin, calling it a waste of money.
Reviewers frequently note it has no scent, absorbs well, and leaves no sticky residue.
Some reviewers were disappointed that the texture was not what they expected, describing it as solid or granulated.
A few reviewers mention ingredient or skin-sensitivity concerns, including coconut-derived ingredients and breakouts.
